policies.question: Does keyword search keep URL conditions authoritative, keep the current result snapshot route-owned, and derive ephemeral view identity only from normalized execution conditions?
policies.desired: URL conditions project into server execution input; the route-owned result snapshot is carried by the route payload and active client store only for that execution; changing the result snapshot cannot change the canonical ephemeral view identity.
verificationPlan: Collect the exact-revision URL/store state inventory, execute negative mutations for authority, identity, and route lifetime, run the current route/service tests, then attest and evaluate the normalized observation in the protected host gate.
